elliot: FYI i hit a parity bug in sampleapps: spans on retry attempts sometimes show request_id as <redacted> even though the first attempt had the real id
maya: can you paste the minimal ordering that reproduces it?
elliot: node sampleapp middleware order that triggers it:
elliot: ```js
app.use(otel.middleware())
app.use(retryMiddleware)   // retries by mutating headers on the request object
app.use(redactionMiddleware) // scrubs sensitive headers for wire/logs
```
elliot: logs: 
elliot: ```
INFO  2026-03-02T09:03:10Z request_id=xyz-9 start
WARN  2026-03-02T09:03:11Z retry attempt=2
INFO  2026-03-02T09:03:11Z request_id=<redacted> finished
```
elliot: result: trace shows attribute request_id=<redacted> on the retried span, but the first span keeps the original id
sujan: that sounds like the retry code mutates the headers object after otel attached the context, and the exporter reads attribute values lazily from the context/header map at export time
maya: python sampleapp behaved differently in our earlier tests because the retry wrapper copies headers into a fresh object rather than mutating; java had yet another ordering depending on filter registration order
harper: two possible approaches: (A) snapshot original header into an immutable span attribute when otel first sees it (e.g., redwood.request_id.orig) or (B) constrain redaction to wire/log layers so it never mutates the context used by spans
elliot: i prototyped (A) in the node sampleapp: on header present do span.setAttribute('redwood.request_id.orig', val) and mark it sensitive so exporters scrub it before sending. quick local runs look promising
sujan: exporter changes are required for safety. we must prevent accidental export of raw ids. suggest an exporter processor that redacts any attribute on a sensitive whitelist and unit tests that validate OTLP payloads have no raw values
maya: also adding devex docs about hook ordering and a short matrix for node/java/python/go that lists common retry libs and their header semantics. that should reduce onboarding surprises
harper: add an e2e test: run sampleapp with redaction enabled + a test otlp collector, retry triggered, assert no raw request ids in OTLP and logs show redacted wire values
telemetry-bot: New issue opened: DEVEX-5012 "sampleapps: request_id mutated on retry due to hook/filter ordering; propose snapshot attr + exporter-scrub" 9https://issuetracker.internal/DEVEX-5012
elliot: action items: elliot -> open sampleapp PR with snapshot + tests; sujan -> prototype exporter scrub + tests; maya -> update devex docs; harper -> add e2e harness and test. i'll link the PRs in the ticket.
maya: also note for docs: recommend middleware order pattern: otel-context-only -> snapshot attrs -> retry libs -> wire redaction
sujan: quick note: for prod exporters we should gate behavior behind a rollout flag; don't change customer-facing exporters without an opt-in until we've validated e2e
harper: ack, i'll make the e2e harness run with a feature flag default-off in integrations
elliot: thanks all, i'll file the PR + reference the ticket. :thumbsup:
